summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a commercial update and a regular monthly cash distribution of US$0.22 per share for May 2026, sourced from Contributed Surplus. The filing details average TCE earnings for its fleet and index-linked charters, with no M&A, restructuring, or special-situation activity. The distribution is a routine capital return to shareholders, not a tender offer or special dividend. There are no deal terms, advisors, or strategic changes involved. This is a standard operational and dividend update with no event-driven or special-situations catalyst to monitor.
